nodes.description: SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): performs c = a + b with require(c >= a) overflow guard.
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): require(b <= a) then c = a - b.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): c = a * b with require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): require(b > 0) then c = a / b.
Owned constructor: sets owner = msg.sender, establishing initial privileged role.
Owned.transferOwnership(address _newOwner) restricted by onlyOwner; stages pending owner in newOwner.
Owned.acceptOwnership(): require(msg.sender == newOwner), moves ownership and zeroes newOwner.
RevalootSwap constructor: sets symbol/name/decimals, mints _totalSupply to a hardcoded address and emits Transfer.
totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] with unchecked subtraction.
balanceOf(address tokenOwner): returns balances[tokenOwner].
transfer(address to, uint tokens): moves tokens between balances using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
approve(address spender, uint tokens): writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval without zero-first check.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): reduces balance and allowance via safeSub then credits 'to' via safeAdd.
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender): returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): writes allowance then calls external contract receiveApproval(...).
Payable fallback function that immediately reverts; rejects plain ETH transfers.
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) onlyOwner: external call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an attacker-chosen address.
address public owner: privileged account used in onlyOwner checks and token rescue.
address public newOwner: pending owner awaiting acceptOwnership.
string public symbol, set to 'REV-S' in constructor.
string public name, set to 'Revaloot Swap' in constructor.
uint8 public decimals, set to 2 in constructor.
uint public _totalSupply: total minted amount, read by totalSupply().
mapping(address => uint) balances: token balances, mutated by transfer/transferFrom.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowed: ERC20 allowances, mutated by approve/transferFrom/approveAndCall.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks and as the implicit source of transfers/approvals.
Arithmetic addition c = a + b inside safeAdd; overflow only guarded by comparison check.
Arithmetic subtraction c = a - b inside safeSub; underflow only guarded by require(b <= a).
Arithmetic multiplication c = a * b inside safeMul with post-hoc division check.
Arithmetic division c = a / b inside safeDiv with require(b > 0).
Unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply().
External call to attacker-supplied spender contract receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) from approveAndCall; arbitrary external code execution.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) inside an onlyOwner function; return value unchecked and external code executed.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, giving the caller privileged role.
Constructor writes the caller address into the owner state variable.
transferOwnership is gated by onlyOwner which compares msg.sender to owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
transferAnyERC20Token is gated by onlyOwner on msg.sender.
owner state variable is read by the onlyOwner check of transferOwnership.
transferOwnership writes the pending owner into newOwner.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner to authorize the caller.
acceptOwnership overwrites owner with the accepted newOwner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
transfer uses msg.sender as the debited account for balances[msg.sender].
approve stores the allowance under allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom debits the caller's allowance allowed[from][msg.sender].
approveAndCall sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the callee.

safeAdd executes the addition c = a + b guarded only by require(c >= a).
safeSub executes c = a - b after require(b <= a).
safeMul executes c = a * b with a division-based overflow check.
safeDiv executes c = a / b after require(b > 0).
